text:
Sam Patel: Heads-up — we just observed a regional routing TTL regression that caused a short-lived surge in routed requests to legacy POPs; some customers in APAC/EU saw elevated embedding latency and a handful of 503s. Postmortem in progress.

Anjali Rao: Thanks Sam. Impact summary? any customer-facing outages or just degraded perf?

Sam Patel: Mostly degraded perf — embedding 95p latency spiked ~2-3x for ~18 minutes starting 08:14 UTC, ~120 customers saw increased error rates >1%. No data integrity issues.

ops-bot: deploy: rollback-routing-config v2026.3.11 triggered by @Sam Patel — started at 08:22 UTC, 5/6 stages passed, canary healthy.

Kevin Chen: Mitigation steps we took: raised routing TTL threshold from 30s -> 300s for the affected route, rolled back the recent weighted-pop routing change, and enabled temporary throttling for the embedding path to limit fanout.

Anjali Rao: Is the service fully back to normal?

Sam Patel: Metrics show tail latency returning to baseline by 08:36 UTC. Error-rate back to normal by 08:40. We're watching for flapping while the new TTL takes effect across edge caches.

Maria Lopez: I've posted a brief customer bulletin draft in #support-digest — can someone from product ops sign-off? (cc @Anjali Rao)

Anjali Rao: Reviewing now. Suggested language: acknowledge impact window, list mitigations, link to status page, offer follow-up.

Sam Patel: Status page: https://status.redwood-inference.com/incidents/2894001111 — will update with timeline + RCA once done.

Kevin Chen: Quick debug snippet for SRE notes — checking ephemeral route table:

```bash
# check route entries and TTLs
rdwctl route list --region apac --filter "pop,embedding"
rdwctl route show --id r-57f3 --fields ttl,weight,backends
```

ops-bot: incident-severity: SEV3 (customer-impacting transient latency spike)

Maria Lopez: Assigning follow-ups: Kevin to finalize mitigation playbook, Sam to author timeline + RCA, Anjali to sign customer comms. Target: postmortem + customer note by EOD.

Sam Patel: Will also add a guard to CI that prevents TTL config changes without a canary TTL increase.

Kevin Chen: I'll open the playbook PR now and tag oncall.

Anjali Rao: Thanks team. I'll coordinate the customer note and ping CS. Will update this thread when the bulletin is live. :white_check_mark:

Maria Lopez: Great — appreciate the fast rollback. Closing monitoring loop but keeping this thread pinned for RCA updates.
